column4: マリアが１２台のチューリップ３号Ｈ型をさっそくいじっている

column5: They need final adjustments to become usable; even if rushed, it will take several days.

column5: You seem totally absorbed over there... just like always.

column4: 魔人レイがランスが留守中に現れたと情報が入る
column5: Information comes in that the Fiend Lei appeared while Rance was away.

column4: いないと思ってちょっと留守にしすぎたか・・
column5: I thought he wasn't here, but maybe I was away a bit too long...

column5: A unit led by Fiend Lei has appeared. Their number is about 10,000.

column4: ハイパービルの方面です。それほど多くないな
column5: They are heading toward Hyperville. Not too many, huh.

column4: 自衛隊を出撃させますかとコパンドンが言うが
column5: Copandon asks if we should deploy the self-defense force,

column4: 必要無い、余計な奴らがいたら邪魔だ、俺の部隊だけで始末する
column5: No need. If unnecessary people get involved, they'll just be a hindrance. I'll deal with it with my own unit.
